el_jadida_page.overview.title: Welcome to El Jadida — Portuguese stone on the Atlantic
el_jadida_page.overview.p1: El Jadida sits on Morocco’s Atlantic Doukkala coast, about an hour south of Casablanca. Its heart is the UNESCO-listed Portuguese City (Mazagan): thick ramparts, the Bastion of the Angel, and the famous underground cistern where a shaft of light falls on still water.la where Doukkala meets the Atlantic
el_jadida_page.overview.p2: Beyond the walls: a working fishing port packed with blue boats, the old Jewish Mellah, Medina lanes and souks, the city beach, and the resort strip of Sidi Bouzid with its open Atlantic horizon. This is rocky and sandy Atlantic shore — not desert, not lagoon harbours, not mountain trail country.

el_jadida_page.tips.title: Practical tips for El Jadida
el_jadida_page.tips.transport.title: Getting around
el_jadida_page.tips.transport.desc: Trains and buses link Casablanca (CMN). Petits taxis cover town, Sidi Bouzid and the station; agree prices for longer coastal hops.
el_jadida_page.tips.bargain.title: Wind & sun
el_jadida_page.tips.bargain.desc: Atlantic trade winds can be strong. Bring a layer for the ramparts and high SPF for beach days.
el_jadida_page.tips.water.title: Tickets & cash
el_jadida_page.tips.water.desc: The cistern has a small entry fee. Carry dirhams for taxis, port snacks and medina shops.

el_jadida_page.faq.title: El Jadida travel FAQ
el_jadida_page.faq.q1.question: How many days in El Jadida?
el_jadida_page.faq.q1.answer: Two days cover the Portuguese City, cistern, ramparts and port. Three days add Sidi Bouzid beach time or a short trip to Azemmour.
el_jadida_page.faq.q2.question: Is El Jadida only about the Portuguese ruins?
el_jadida_page.faq.q2.answer: The UNESCO walls and cistern are the headline, but the fishing port, Mellah, souks and Atlantic beaches give a full coastal-town stay.
el_jadida_page.faq.q3.question: How do I get to El Jadida?
el_jadida_page.faq.q3.answer: Fly into Casablanca (CMN), then continue by train or road in about an hour. Direct coaches also run from major cities.
el_jadida_page.faq.q4.question: Best time to visit?
el_jadida_page.faq.q4.answer: April–June and September–November for milder weather and fewer crowds. Summer is for swimming; winter can be windy and wetter.
